newsitem.title: USA: Amresco to buy Idaho firm for $42 mln stock.
newsitem.headline: Amresco to buy Idaho firm for $42 mln stock.

text.p: Amresco Inc said it entered a definitive agreement to buy Boise, Idaho-based commercial finance company Commercial Lending Corp for about $42 million in stock.
In a press statement, Amresco said the acquisition would be "nominally accretive in the first year with substantial improvement in accretion of year two of consolidated operations."
Officials at Amresco were not immediately available to comment further.
Commercial Lending will be renamed Amresco Commercial Lending Corp after the acquisition, which is expected to close April 15, Amresco said.
Robert Lutz, Amresco's chairman and chief executive, said in the statement that the acquisition allows Amresco to enter the franchised commercial lending niche market.
"This market has substantial opportunity for growth and high quality loan production," he added."
